versions.subject: fix: condition
versions.detection:
selection:
   ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\notepad.exe'
      - '\calc.exe'
      - '\minesweeper.exe'
      - '\winver.exe'
      - '\bitsadmin.exe'
selection_special:
   ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\csrss.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
      - '\schtasks.exe'
      - '\eventvwr.exe'
filter_special:
   Image|endswith:
      - '\WerFault.exe'
      - '\wermgr.exe'
      - '\conhost.exe'  # csrss.exe, certutil.exe
      - '\mmc.exe'      # eventvwr.exe
condition: selection or ( selection_special and not filter_special )
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("*\\notepad.exe", "*\\calc.exe", "*\\minesweeper.exe", "*\\winver.exe", "*\\bitsadmin.exe") OR (ParentImage IN ("*\\csrss.exe", "*\\certutil.exe", "*\\schtasks.exe", "*\\eventvwr.exe") NOT (Image IN ("*\\WerFault.exe", "*\\wermgr.exe", "*\\conhost.exe", "*\\mmc.exe")))
